subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw tests for the `exec_command` warning path?
rationale: The code-level fix is well-supported, but repository policy requires dependency/Codex contract proof and real behavior proof for this contributor PR, and the current producer path leaves live-route uncertainty.

options.title: Require live proof after refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebase plus redacted terminal output, logs, linked artifact, or recording from a real Codex app-server run showing both read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly decide that the sibling Codex source contract and focused OpenClaw helper tests are sufficient despite no live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause or replace the branch
options.body: Pause this PR or replace it with a maintainer-owned branch if the contributor cannot refresh the conflict and produce the missing evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live proof after refresh
